text: this 'walls hidden' still makes the wall there, look at the outline. [Image #1] i cant select the item inside of here because there was walls in the way
resolution: Hiding a wall's render didn't stop it blocking SELECTION or drawing its outline: the editor build pane picks via a JS raycast over piece DATA (GAME_BUILD.placed.raycast), not the rendered mesh, so a hidden wall still ate the click ('i cant select the item inside') and its blue selection outline still drew. In LoaderIsoView, a piece is now classed as a wall via catalog.family (covers built-in AND cooked walls); while hide-walls is on: select/multi-select/placement-snap raycast a walls-filtered piece set so clicks pass through to the interior item, any selected wall is dropped from the selection, and no wall selection outline is drawn. Pure editor-side TS (no Zig). Verified by clean ship/bundle; live click-through needs the user to test in rjit dev (the editor pane can't be headless-captured).
